name: bounded-buffer
title: Producer and consumer over a buffer of capacity two
source: Textbook bounded buffer (Dijkstra, "Cooperating sequential processes", 1965, §4). Boolean encoding and the off-by-one fault written for this zoo; the bounded buffer of the earlier Gemini session was not available (see README).
note: Count is encoded as two bits, 00/01/10; the invariant forbids the fourth code. The broken producer no longer checks the bound, so the count leaves the encoding.
